attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a RabbitMQ 3.13.7 cluster (Erlang 26), created a payments vhost with a durable quorum queue "orders" replicated across all 3 nodes, and an app_user account with full permissions on payments. Demonstrated that a durable/persistent message survives loss of the queue leader node (node1) and remains consumable from the surviving nodes, with automatic quorum leader failover to node3. Completed the mandatory per-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id + cluster/queue health for each node, restarted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirmed changed boot_id after each, and verified full cluster (3/3 nodes running) and quorum queue recovery (3/3 members online, message intact) after each restart. Final end-to-end publish/consume test succeeded post-recovery.
